title: SQL Injection - Administrator Authentication Exploit
impact: Allows authentication to succeed as the administrator (admin@juice-sh.op) without providing the correct password potentially granting access to privileged application functions.
remediation: Use prepared statements or parameterized queries instead of dynamically constructed SQL; implement server-side validation and secure authentication checks.

title: SQL Injection - Credential Extraction Through Product Search

impact: Retrieves user account information including email addresses and password hashes from the database through the product-search functionality.

title: Reflected XSS Through Search Input
impact: A specially crafted search URL can cause injected JavaScript to run in the browser of a user who opens it potentially allowing unauthorized actions within that user's session.
remediation: Encode output according to its context and avoid unsafe DOM rendering methods; implement a restrictive Content Security Policy (CSP).

title: Persistent XSS in Administrator User Listing
impact: Injected content saved as a user's email address may execute when an administrator views the user listing potentially exposing privileged browser functionality.
remediation: Apply proper output encoding and input validation; do not render untrusted content as HTML and enforce an appropriate Content Security Policy.
